questions.text:
What does the following fragment of C-program print?
char c []="GATE2011";
char *p =c;
printf ("%s", p + p[3]- p[ 1 ]);
questions.solution:
p[3] = 'E' (69), p[1] = 'A' (65), so p + 69 [latex]-[/latex] 65 = p + 4.

p + 4 points to "2011".

Answer: 2011
